g.text: C23 cleanup ingress: request, nested drain and storage custody
stop fresh ingress; keep current scopes and their roots
reserve before close; no late unbounded new work
consume exact grant; return or retained unknown
end_sfun and marker/root duties before parent settlement
never synchronously wait for requesting callback itself
children and unused grants settled; guard only once
physical drain and termination remain independent
release callback / origin holds can outlive execution
also require storage closure; unknown retains custody
